# TSMP Codec Luma4 0.0.4-beta.2

Pair this beta with **TSMP Core 0.3.0-beta.3 or newer** (UPM pins 0.3.0-beta.3).

## Changes

- Support combined decoder byte output: write the decoded header prefix and payload directly to Core's readback target, eliminating a payload intermediate and a packing draw.
- Preserve the legacy shader path, codec ID, packet layout, quantization behavior and existing asset GUIDs.
- Reuse native encoder-owned raster buffers and opt in to Core's GPU Luma4 encoder. Materials are prepared automatically and CPU fallback remains available.
- Core 0.3.0-beta.2 and older do not provide the new buffered/GPU writer APIs; update Core before installing this release.

## Measurements and Validation

The paired Core/Luma4 profile reduced mean Udon encoder time from **11.27 to 0.457 ms** at 720p / 4 KiB / 60 Hz. The small 360p / 32 B raster helper decreased from **0.158 to 0.066 ms**. This includes Core changes and is not an isolated codec speedup.

GPU encoding adds a conversion pass. The measured 720p Gamma GPU draw median was about **16.5 us versus 8.3 us** for expansion alone, excluding transfers/readback. Native Gamma/Linear and compiled Udon CPU/GPU pixel comparisons passed.

Combined-output regression passed exact-byte checks, codec switching, payload growth/shrink, same-snapshot fallback, CRC rejection, cancellation and concurrent decoders in native Windows Player and the compiled SDK Editor VM. Removing a draw is not by itself proof of lower frame loss or a measured GPU-time saving.

Environment: Unity 2022.3.22f1, Windows / D3D11, RTX 4090, i9-13900K; Worlds SDK 3.10.4-beta.2 and bundled UdonSharp; native Development Mono Player. Live VRChat, Quest, other GPUs/APIs and IL2CPP were not verified.

[Core release notes: full measurements, latency tradeoffs and evidence](https://github.com/kibalab/TSMP-Core/releases/tag/v0.3.0-beta.3)

## Installation

Update Core first. In VCC, enable prereleases at https://vpm.kiba.red/ and explicitly select TSMP Codec Luma4 **0.0.4-beta.2**. Ordinary Unity remains supported through UPM without VRCSDK. No extra context-menu setup or protocol migration is required.
